parsed.explanation: No visitor-facing restriction is documented: no criminalisation, no facility or custody rule, no police targeting, no organised violence, no border data either way. Positives carry real weight — functioning courts have granted trans people relief (2024 regional ruling; March 2026 birth-certificate order defeating civil-status appeals), the equality council has enforced decisions, Pride operates at scale, and legislative/governmental bans on gender-identity discussion were struck down or stripped out. Negatives: anti-discrimination and hate-crime provisions omit gender identity, institutional follow-through is 'limited', LGR procedure is abusive (resident-facing), and official rhetoric (PM opposing marker changes, campaign hostility) signals state-level unfriendliness plus conservative social attitudes — tier-3 hostility potential with partial recourse. No universal exposure or state threat-framing exists to pull it into the 0.60s band floor; open border/custody questions are lighter than documented goods. Reduced Risk.
